ladder: Boats for Sale / Brand Catalog / Vessel Types > vessel type (mini yachts, superyachts, motor yachts, sailing yachts, center console, speed boats) > location or brand
facets: make or model; full price; length; location; keyword
notes: Leads with vessel type, then location or brand; filters size and price.

ladder: Adult bikes > sports bikes (mountain, hybrid, road and gravel) / leisure bikes (commuter, folding, Dutch, trikes) > gender; kids; electric
facets: price; frame size (men's XS-XL, unisex S-L); in stock; on sale
notes: Use-type tree; electric is a separate top branch; frame size is the main fit filter.

ladder: Smart bikes / electric bikes / kids bikes > category > popular range (Novus, Captus, Motus)
notes: Maker site: leads with product line; page held no road-bike content.

ladder: Level by body class and size: micro > small > compact > mid > mid-large > large; SUV small to large; MPV; sports car; pickup; vans
quality_markers: size class by wheelbase and length bands
notes: Size class within body type; separate size ladders for car, SUV, MPV.

quality_markers: few problems in daily use; simple reliable technology; proven maturity; build quality
quality_signals: J.D. Power Initial Quality Study (problems per 100 vehicles, 90 days, then 3 years); expert magazines
notes: Problems per 100 vehicles is the yardstick; a model can differ from its brand.

quality_signals: Euro NCAP 0 to 5 stars from adult, child, vulnerable road user and Safety Assist areas; independent body
notes: Safety scale revised about every three years, gets stricter.
Gravel called a commercial umbrella label; roadie and MTB camps have looks; tribe not readable from bike.

ladder: intended riding > own research of categories > list and budget > test ride > ownership costs; types cruiser, sport, touring, adventure
quality_markers: how you will ride, not looks or spec; fit by test ride; running costs
notes: Motorcycle choice starts from kind of riding, then type.

ladder: Buy > town or postcode > price, bedrooms, property type > results > Filters
facets: bathrooms; added or reduced date; tenure (freehold, leasehold, share of freehold); must haves (garden, parking, new home, retirement, auction); don't show
notes: Location first, then price, bedrooms and type; tenure is a filter, not a level.

ladder: Category (rental; new condominium; new detached house; land; pre-owned condominium; pre-owned detached house) > address, rail line or station > map area
facets: commute time from station; features (pet-friendly, parking, balcony, renovated); keyword
notes: Leads with dwelling type and new or used, then station and line; station time is key.

ladder: Rent or buy > property type (apartment, house, shared flat, commercial) > map or list
notes: Transaction type first, then property type.

ladder: location > condition of home > due diligence (title, LIM) > personal requirements > other costs
quality_markers: location; condition; legal title and reports; fit to household
notes: Location is first; legal due diligence before personal fit.

ladder: neighbourhood > general appearance > structural > water > electrical and appliances > liveability
quality_markers: neighbourhood; structure; damp and plumbing; wiring; energy efficiency and orientation
quality_signals: building and pest inspection before an offer
notes: Area before the building; professional inspection recommended before offer.

ladder: budget and mortgage > exterior > interior > neighbourhood > professional survey
quality_markers: roof and walls; damp; electrics and heating; neighbourhood; independent survey
quality_signals: RICS Level 2 and Level 3 surveys named
notes: Survey firm; survey levels are the formal condition grade.

quality_markers: running costs for heating, hot water, lighting
quality_signals: EPC A to G (A 92+ down to G 1-20) by accredited assessor; government EPC register; separate CO2 rating
notes: Legal in England and Wales; one grade buyers can compare for any home.
